decisions.reason: The modular waste-to-energy extensions build directly on the firm's core plant engineering and prototyping knowledge, so it can still interpret and use market feedback, although their absence from the website in 2020–2021 raises doubt about their continued prominence.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant rests on the firm's deepest energy-from-waste expertise and is supported by its own R&D and university cooperation, so it remains a core application worth developing despite the lack of website signals in recent years.

Plastic-to-fuel conversion sits close to the firm's conversion know-how and benefits from its research partnerships, but the newer technology's uncertainty and its missing website presence since 2020 make withdrawal more likely than for the core plants.
